READING THIS INGREDIENT

WHAT TO CHECK ON THE LABEL
Vitamin D3 amount and unit
In mcg or IU. For vitamin D, 1 mcg equals 40 IU, so convert before comparing.
Vitamin K2 form and amount
K2 comes as menaquinones such as MK-4 or MK-7. The label should say which, and how much.
Omega-3 amounts
Omega-3 is included as triglycerides. Look for the amount, ideally with EPA and DHA stated.
Serving and source

READING THIS INGREDIENT

Different iron compounds contain different proportions of iron by weight. NIH's Office of Dietary Supplements, for example, lists ferrous fumarate at 33% elemental iron and ferrous sulfate at 20%. That's why compound weight and elemental iron should never be confused.

NIH Office of Dietary Supplements — Iron: Fact Sheet for Health Professionals
